page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that the 2 vCPUs do not share physical execution resources with other tenants, offering consistent processing capabilities.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g8i.large offers a standard resource density suitable for entry-level enterprise workloads that require dedicated CPU resources without the overhead of high-capacity local storage or specialized accelerators. It is positioned for general-purpose workloads, such as lightweight web serving, microservices, small database instances, and development or testing environments.
